page.layout: One block of verse: a single column of poetry, lines set in italic with some indented lines; running head at the top centre; page number at the top right.

main_text.p:
Moribus castis, placidis, pudicis:
At que praestanti pietate claram,
Flore iuuenta.

Illa te pulchra faceret parentem
Prole, maturos aperire partus
Si Deus magni voluisset orbis
Arbiter aequus.

Optimo visum est aliter Parenti,
Qui simul sedes superas inire
Sanxerat matrem, & genitum latentem
Matris in aluo.

Sic piam vita potiore donans
Foeminam, noftin' quibus aduocarit
Gaudiis, & quàm recreet suaui
Nectaris hauftu?

Illa nunc firmo fruitur fauore
Numinis: nullos metuit dolorum
Impetus: nec dura furentis horret
Classica Martis,

Qui fremit toto violentum orbe,
Qui rapax latè populatur agros,
Qui feris magnas rabidus cruentat
Stragibus urbes.

Illa nunc terras nitido iacentes
Despicit caelo, vigilesque curas
Gentis humanae, & fugientis aui
Somnia ridet.

page.notes:
Lines are set as verse; the printed line breaks are shown with
inside each stanza. Some words are doubtful in the scan: "noftin'" and "nullos" read as printed; "Nectaris" and "hauftu?" are uncertain at the line end. Several letters are worn in the middle of the page.
